detail: A cast from the tower produces the world. Not a representation of it, not a description handed to a generator — the cast is the generation, and the world-gen stage is the tower's output. A generation failure is a fizzle: a visible null that spends the allocation and never dresses itself as scenery.
note: The tower is the generation point. Requisition failures (no-item, no-manifest, no-render) are fizzles, not pipeline errors.
